description_for_human: Busca jurisprudencial e jurimetria preditiva em 67M+ decisões de 55 tribunais brasileiros.
description_for_model: Search and analyze 67 million Brazilian court decisions across 55 courts. Use this tool for: legal research (buscar_jurisprudencia), predicting case outcomes (predicao_resultado), analyzing judge behavior (perfil_relator, estrategia_juiz), finding similar precedents (similaridade), detecting divergence between court chambers (divergencia_turmas), tracking jurisprudential evolution (evolucao_jurisprudencial), generating legal documents grounded in real case law (gerar_peca), and verifying legal citations for accuracy (verificar_citacao).
